{{Quote|I wound up destroying their world.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Oben''' was a resource-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], and was a colony of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
Following the [[Huk War]], the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] desecrated the burial grounds of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] there, prompting [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to return from working for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to again lead the [[kolkpravis]]. The [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] sabotaged Grievous's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Martyr]]'', nearly [[Death/Legends|killing]] him and killing seven of the eight [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]], elite warriors who protected him and carried out his will.<ref name="Unknown">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> The sole surviving Izvoshra, a tyrant of Kalee's western hemisphere named [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], rallied the kolkpravis and led the [[Attack on Oben|slaughter of the Yam'rii]] on Oben, where he subsequently moved his people.<ref name="GaW" />

Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was tasked with [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|pacification]] of the fringe of the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and was forced to [[Bombardment of Oben|raze]] Oben. Sk'ar left to join the Empire,<ref name="aite">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}}</ref> and the kolkpravis was taken over by a [[Unidentified female Kaleesh leader|female Kaleesh]] believed to be the second coming of Grievous's dead soulmate, [[Ronderu lij Kummar]].<ref name="GaW" />
